records.real_world_identity_notes: Iveco racing truck of the Brazilian Copa Truck championship, one of the manufacturers the series lists among its competitors.
records.confidence_basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by registered sources.
records.identity_basis: Registered sources establish the championship and its mandated gearbox, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
records.specification_basis: The championship regulations mandate a mechanically operated H-pattern manual gearbox, and the reference gives a 5-speed plus launch gear. The live drive selected six H-pattern gears, which is that 5+1.
records.confidence_notes: Guided testing directly established the six H-pattern gears on a standard gate, the standing-start clutch, the clutchless running shift, and the absence of automatic cut and blip.
control_notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled. There is no automatic cut or blip, so the driver lifts to upshift.

The gearbox is a five-speed plus a launch gear, and first is only used to pull away. A tester found first effectively unavailable in normal running and thought it a fault; it is the real specification faithfully modelled, and the six observed gears are that 5+1.

The regulations mandate a mechanically operated H-pattern manual gearbox but leave its design free, so the engagement type is not established and the downshift blip stays unknown rather than being inferred from racing practice.

records.real_world_identity_notes: Pickup-bodied racer of the Brazilian Copa Chevrolet Montana, a series that ran from 2010 to 2012. It carries a 5.7-litre carburetted V8 of about 369 hp at some 1,360 kg, shifted by a sequential stick.
records.confidence_basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by registered sources.
records.identity_basis: A registered reference establishes the series and its sequential gearbox, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
records.specification_basis: The reference gives a sequential stick gearbox with five gears, and the live drive selected five gears through a sequential stick with automatic cut and blip.
records.confidence_notes: Guided testing directly established five gears through a sequential stick, the standing-start clutch, the clutchless running shift, and automatic cut and blip. Confidence is medium because the only reviewed source is a community reference rather than a championship or manufacturer publication.
control_notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: automatic cut on upshifts and automatic blip on downshifts, so the driver supplies neither.
